The $0.075 per minute headline on this page is the Voice Agent (STT + managed LLM + TTS), NOT speech-to-text. Speech-to-text alone is $0.0043-$0.0092 per minute by model and tier, i.e. 8-17x cheaper than the number usually quoted. Reading the agent rate as an STT rate makes Deepgram look ~17x more expensive than it is.
Deepgram's $200 credit is the free tier; it expires, so it is not a price.
Aura-2 is $0.030/1k characters pay-as-you-go and $0.027 on Growth; Aura-1 is $0.015/$0.0135. The TTS side does have a tier ladder even though the STT headline does not.

No affiliate programme is listed for this vendor, so there is no link on this page.
